mathlib_ai_policy.source: Lean community, 'How to contribute', section 'Use of AI' (leanprover-community.github.io/contribute/index.html), fetched 2026-10-25 through a fetch tool that returns only short quotations (<= 125 characters each)
mathlib_ai_policy.text: "Using an LLM when writing comments on GitHub or Zulip is not allowed: use your own words." ... "you must explain this in the PR description." ... "code written by an AI without the supervision of a Lean subject expert fails to meet that bar by a large margin." ... "It is essential that you understand all the content written by an AI." (The page also asks for the LLM-generated label on pull requests with a substantial amount of LLM-generated code; that sentence was returned as a paraphrase, not a verbatim quote.)
